text: The City's annual balanced budget, prepared using a cash basis of accounting rather than the accrual basis used for financial reporting purposes, outlines the funds required to support the City's anticipated operating expenses for the fiscal year, along with funds required to support the planned acquisition or development of tangible capital assets. As a result, Ontario Regulation 286/09 "Budget Matters - Expenses" (Regulation) specifically permits the City of Toronto (City) to exclude the following expenses from its annual balanced budget: amortization expenses, post-employment benefits expenses, and solid waste landfill closure and post-closure expenses.
